Pentera provides an exposure validation platform that tests security controls with AI-driven adversarial testing in production, confirms which exposures are exploitable, and supports remediation of them. Its customers are security teams and CISOs at organizations across industries, testing internal networks, external assets, cloud, web applications, APIs and hybrid environments.

SeeTree sells AI crop intelligence, including a yield forecasting product that provides pre-season yield forecasts at block, farm, and company level, plus aerial tree surveys and a mobile-first farm management application that combine satellite imagery, weather data, drone analytics, mobile sensing, and field scouting. Its customers are agribusinesses growing citrus, sugarcane, palm, and forestry crops.

KITOV.ai offers an AI-based software platform that automates CAD-based visual inspection planning, letting QC engineers define inspection requirements directly on a CAD model. The platform is sold to machine builders, system integrators, planners, and large manufacturers, and is used across industries such as electronics, automotive, defense, medical, and retail.

EmbodyMe builds AI driven technology for generating and controlling visual elements in images and video, including Neural Rendering, 3D Dense Face Tracking, and products such as the xpression camera virtual camera app, the xpression chat app, the xpression avatar, and a real-time AI video generation SDK for iOS, Android, Windows, and Mac. Its tools are made for creative users who produce visual content, such as people using video chat and live streaming platforms, smartphone apps, AI chatbots, video production, advertising, and gaming.

Datarails FinanceOS is a governed, Excel-connected operating layer that consolidates financial and operational data from over 600 sources into one source of truth, and the Datarails FP&A product runs planning, budgeting, forecasting and dashboards on that data within Excel. It is built for finance teams across industries and company sizes, and it is used by finance teams at more than 2,000 companies.

aibuy offers shoppable video products, including Shoppable Overlay, which adds an interactive overlay to videos so viewers can explore products and buy without leaving the content, plus Multicart, T-Commerce, and Floating Cart. Its products are used by companies that want to create additional revenue streams and grow their return on ad spend through interactive shoppable content and ads, including influencer marketing, QR code campaigns, and sites selling products across multiple pages. The products can be white-labeled, which allows a tailored and consistent user experience.

EngFlow offers build management software for Bazel, including Remote Execution that distributes builds and tests across a cluster of machines and remotely caches the results, plus an open-source Bazel Invocation Analyzer that generates recommendations for performance improvements from a Bazel profile. Its products are sold to software development teams that build and test large codebases with Bazel, and the company's customers include companies such as Viasat, Brave and Shift.

Pentest People sells penetration testing, a simulated attack on a computer system, network, or web application that is used to find security weaknesses. Its penetration testing services are offered to organisations that want to identify and address security gaps before malicious actors can exploit them.

AccuLynx is an all-in-one management platform that connects everyone in a business, from the field to the office, in real time. AccuLynx is sold to roofing contractors and roofing businesses, which it helps run their operations. AccuLynx provides customer service at no extra cost, including U.S.-based phone support and training.

CheckMarket offers Agile Research, a DIY survey platform with flexible survey building from scratch or from templates, advanced statistical analysis such as maxdiff and conjoint, and real-time customizable reporting. It is used by research and insights teams to run consumer research, including customer insights, one-off customer satisfaction surveys, marketing and brand research, and product research.

BrowserStack provides a cloud platform that lets developer teams test websites and mobile applications for functionality, performance, and visual appeal on real browsers and devices. Its customers are developer and QA teams that build websites, web apps, and mobile apps and need to test them across browsers, operating systems, and devices.

Shopic makes a computer vision-based, AI-powered clip-on device that attaches to a standard shopping cart and turns it into a smart cart for the length of a visit. Its smart cart solution is sold to medium and large supermarkets and grocery chains, which deploy it on the retail floor. Shopic's device is mounted only on the cart and used only during shopping, so it does not affect the store's infrastructure and requires no servers.

TurboTenant offers rental property management software and services, including tenant screening, rent collection, lease agreements, maintenance requests, and accounting. It is built for landlords who want to manage their rental properties with less time spent on day-to-day tasks.

Nym offers AI medical coding automation, using a clinical language understanding engine that turns provider documentation in patient charts into medical billing codes. Nym's autonomous medical coding platform is sold to healthcare providers, including hospitals, health systems, and physician groups, to automate revenue cycle management.

Adranos makes solid rocket motors and the ALITEC solid rocket fuel, a proprietary aluminum-lithium alloy propellant that can increase missile range by up to 40% while saving costs. Its customers are prime contractors that build missiles, hypersonics and other propulsion systems for the defense industry, and the propellant is also aimed at the space industry. The company says its manufacturing process for solid rocket motors is significantly faster and more efficient than techniques used by legacy manufacturers.

Freedcamp is a web-based project management software that helps teams organize tasks, calendars, discussions, and templates, with native iOS and Android apps, desktop apps for Mac and Windows, and a separate chat app. It is sold to teams and businesses, including small and medium-sized businesses, startups, non-profit organizations, and students and teachers.

Xalient provides identity-driven security and networking, including IT consulting and managed services that cover identity, software-defined security, cyber security and networking. Xalient works as a global boutique focused exclusively on the convergence of identity-driven security and networking.

CRED is a members-only app that lets credit card users pay their card bills, manage multiple cards, track card spending, and check their credit score. It is sold to credit card holders with a high credit score, who are invited to join as members and receive rewards for timely card bill payments. Members receive exclusive rewards, such as cashback, experiences, and upgrades from partner brands, when they pay their credit card bills through the app.

Perception Point offers a cloud-native security product that protects against file- and URL-based attacks across content-exchange channels, including email, with its Internal Email Security product detecting threats such as malware, phishing, impersonation, and APTs. Its solutions are built for digital-first enterprises that need to protect content exchanges across the organization through any channel.

UBQ Materials has developed a patented thermoplastic, UBQ™, made from residual solid waste that would otherwise go to landfill, as an alternative to oil-based plastic. The material is intended for manufacturers in the materials and manufacturing industry, who use it as a raw material. UBQ™ is described as the world's first alternative to oil-based plastic made entirely from mixed household waste, including all organics.

Simularge builds physics-based digital twins that connect to sensors, machines, and production systems to collect real-time process data, model hidden process conditions, and suggest process adjustments when defect risks emerge. Simularge's digital twins are sold to manufacturers, including automotive, defence and aerospace, and advanced manufacturing producers that need consistent quality across high-volume or precision production lines. Simularge's digital twins are built on engineering models combined with production data, and its case study with Beko reports 96% thermal accuracy, a 20% improvement in OEE, and annual savings of €2M.

Gloat sells Agentic HR, a set of pre-built and no-code-buildable AI workforce agents that handle HR tasks from transactional questions to workflow and strategic planning, powered by its Loomra workforce context engine. Its agents are sold to enterprises and HR teams, which use them for talent matching, skills, career pathing, and workforce planning inside tools such as Teams, Slack, and their HCM system. Unlike rules-based automation, the agents are described as using goal-directed reasoning and acting autonomously, with actions that are explainable, auditable, and reversible under the customer's own policies.

Elenium builds self-service kiosks and bag drops that use intelligent automation to cut passenger queues at airports. Its customers are airlines and airports, which use the systems to give passengers faster self-service check-in and bag drop. Airlines can activate their services at any airport themselves, which the company describes as putting airlines in control of common use self-service technology.

AYOXXA Biosystems GmbH has developed a proprietary technology platform for multiplex protein analysis, built on a bead-based system (IEBA) that requires the lowest sample volume in the multiplex protein field and can be read with existing equipment. The platform is aimed at biomedical research, pharmacological screening and preclinical diagnostics development. The bead-based system yields 10,000-fold more data points than a standard 384-well ELISA.

SimplePractice sells practice management software, an EHR, that helps practitioners handle admin work, scheduling, billing, and clinical care. Its software is sold to mental health and wellness professionals, including therapists, speech-language pathologists, occupational therapists, and psychiatrists.
The platform is built to power SLG, PLG, self-service, and consumption-based go-to-market (GTM) motions.

Mitti, formerly SafetyCulture, is an operations system for the frontline that connects people, workflows and operational data into one place, covering quality management, asset maintenance, training, compliance and insurance. It is used by frontline teams across hospitality, construction, manufacturing, retail and facilities management, with more than two million workers across 80,000 organizations.

Pynt offers automated, dynamic API security testing, using behavior-based discovery and testing to find and help fix API vulnerabilities during development. Its customers are developers and testers, including enterprise and global brands, who need to manage API security during the development lifecycle. Pynt's approach uses live-traffic context to detect business logic flaws and requires no configuration.

Antheia uses a biosynthesis platform, built on engineered microbes, to produce biosynthetic pharmaceutical ingredients. Antheia's ingredients are made for pharmaceutical manufacturing, including ingredients for the opioid overdose treatment Narcan.

Ibex Medical Analytics sells AI-powered digital pathology solutions that help detect and analyze cancer from tissue samples. Its customers are pathology laboratories and physicians, and its solutions are used in cancer diagnostics.

Apptopia sells mobile app data and analytics, including Apptopia Base, Apptopia Advanced, and Sector Data Packages, which show mobile app behavior and engagement. Its customers are investors and financial firms, who use its mobile consumer activity data to analyze public companies and inform investment decisions.

Sedric is an AI-powered platform that reviews marketing, communications, and partner content against a company's policies and applies real-time guardrails to that content. Sedric is built for banks, fintechs, RIAs, and ARM firms in financial services, serving compliance, risk, and marketing teams. Sedric links each flag to the underlying regulation and logs every override with its reasoning.

Deel IT is a platform for running global IT operations, where companies buy, lease, configure, ship, and manage devices such as laptops, phones, monitors, and accessories from one system. It is built for companies with remote and global teams, from lean teams without dedicated IT staff to growing organizations and complex global teams across more than 130 countries. HR events such as hires, role changes, and exits trigger IT actions automatically, and policies apply consistently across devices, teams, and countries.

Clearcover sells car insurance through its app, which uses claims technology to scan damaged vehicles, analyze claims, and pay eligible claims in minutes. Clearcover sells car insurance to drivers who want affordable coverage, and it also offers its policies through insurance agents and embedded partner programs.

Headway is a changelog service that lets companies publish product updates on a public changelog page, with a widget, Markdown editor, custom categories, and scheduled publishing. Its customers are app and web-app developers and product teams who want to keep their users informed about changes to their product.

Verbit sells a verbal intelligence and voice AI platform that combines automatic speech recognition with human transcribers to provide captioning, transcription, translation, audio description, dubbing and note taking services. Verbit sells its services to businesses and institutions across industries such as courtrooms, law firms, law enforcement, education, government, corporate and market research, and media and entertainment.

AIVF develops AI-powered IVF solutions, including an AI platform that grades embryos and provides insights on embryo quality. AIVF sells its solutions to IVF clinics, embryology labs, clinicians, embryologists and patients.

Anodot provides an AI-driven platform that monitors business and operational metrics, learns normal behavior, and detects anomalies and business incidents in real time. Its customers are data-driven enterprises in areas such as payments, transactions, user engagement, telecom, eCommerce, adtech, gaming, and fintech. The platform works without manual thresholds or dashboards, and it is backed by several patented technologies.

Upstream offers a cybersecurity and intelligence platform for physical AI, automotive and smart mobility systems. Its automotive cybersecurity and data management solutions are offered to companies that build and operate connected vehicles.

Broadsign provides the Broadsign Platform, software that helps media owners and retailers manage physical spaces as media channels, streamline operations, and maximize revenue. Its customers are media owners, retailers, agencies, and brands that plan, buy, and deliver out-of-home and in-store advertising campaigns.

Razorpay's POS swipe machines are in-store payment terminals, including the All-in-One POS, Smart POS with Dock, and Android Mini POS, that accept payments, capture loyalty signups, and run offers. The swipe machines are sold to businesses and retailers that run in-store checkouts.

Superhuman is an AI productivity suite that includes Superhuman Mail, Superhuman Docs, and Superhuman Go, an AI assistant that works in the tools people already use. Superhuman sells its tools to individuals and to enterprise organizations that want to write, plan, and communicate more effectively.

Myndshft sells automated prior authorization software, which uses generative AI, machine learning, and workflow automation to handle benefit checks and prior authorizations within a customer's existing systems. Its customers include providers, payers, pharmacies, PBMs, and drug manufacturers, and the software is used for diagnostics and genomics labs, specialty pharmacies, and infusion providers. The software integrates with any system of record, including EHRs, health information systems, and revenue cycle and claims management solutions, and it works in the background without requiring major workflow changes.

Malt is an integrated freelance management system (FMS) that centralizes and manages the entire independent talent lifecycle, including contract and project management and task-based payment. Malt is sold to businesses that engage freelance and independent talent, with procurement teams gaining visibility over projects and teams launching projects quickly.

Chibig is an indie video game studio that develops and markets its own adventure video games, which share one universe. Its games are aimed at a broad audience of players who enjoy adventure games with a strong artistic personality.

Tesorion is a Dutch, independent cybersecurity service provider that offers managed security, consultancy, secure infrastructure and incident response, and its Tesorion Immunity product provides Network Access Control with network security for device control, access, and segmentation. Tesorion works with organizations that need protection against cybercrime and business risk, and it protects their organization 24/7, as shown in its customer cases such as Dozon.

Craif sells miSignal Scan, a urine-based cancer risk test built on its proprietary NANO IP biomarker analysis platform and AI, which detects cancer-specific signals from microRNA. Craif's test is offered to people who want to check their cancer risk at home before any symptoms appear, and the company is developing medical devices for early detection of pancreatic cancer.

Rapid Liquid Print sells Gravity Free Manufacturing, a digital process that prints elastomeric parts directly into a suspended environment using its Veer software, and it offers the Levity printer. Its process serves customers across industries who need products of all sizes made with mass customization and designs that traditional molds cannot produce.

Practo offers an online platform where consumers can find doctors, book appointments, and hold video consultations with verified doctors. Its services are sold to patients and consumers seeking healthcare, including doctors, clinics, and hospitals that use its software and listing tools.

Syte sells a product discovery platform powered by visual AI, which includes visual and text search, personalization, and automated product tagging. Syte's platform is sold to ecommerce brands and retailers, including apparel ecommerce businesses, to help shoppers find and buy products online. Syte's visual discovery journeys are designed to help shoppers instantly find items they will love and drive conversion.

Forter sells identity intelligence technology and fraud prevention products, including fraud management, payment optimization, dispute management, account protection, and abuse prevention. Forter's customers are online brands and merchants in digital commerce, such as Adidas, eBay, Wayfair, and ASOS, and it also offers its product to payment service providers.

Deep Longevity sells aging clocks, including Blood Age, Mind Age, Biometric Age, and Epigenetic Age, and provides them through its SenoClock and SenoClock Gold SaaS platforms, which generate biological age predictions and health summary reports. Its customers are enterprise customers and employers who use the platforms with their employees, as well as patients and individuals who receive personalised health and longevity recommendations in consultation with their physicians. The company states that its approach combines measures from blood, DNA, and microbiome with psychological surveys.

Tevel Aerobotics builds Flying Autonomous Robots that pick fruit in orchards, using artificial intelligence, computer vision, and machine learning to determine the ripeness of each fruit and pick it with minimal bruising. The robots are sold to fruit growers and farm operators, such as HMC Farms in California and the Unifrutti Group in Chile, who harvest apricots, nectarines, plums, pears, apples, and peaches. The robots also collect data on each fruit they pick, including quantity, size, weight, ripeness, and disease detection, and report it to farmers in real time.

Vertice is an intelligent procurement platform that uses agentic workflows and AI insights to automate purchasing work, from intake and approvals to invoice payment and SaaS purchasing. It is built for finance and procurement teams in the modern enterprise.

Agnikul Cosmos designs and manufactures orbital-class launch vehicles powered by 3D-printed engines. The company offers custom payloads and private launches, giving customers their own dedicated launch for their satellites. Its mobile launchpad lets satellites be deployed from a location chosen for each mission, and its clusterable configuration allows the number of engines to be selected based on mission requirements.

Critical Start sells Managed Detection and Response (MDR) services that provide 24x7x365 monitoring, investigation, and response, combining AI-powered triage with human-led investigation. Critical Start serves organizations that need outsourced security monitoring and response across endpoint, cloud, identity, OT/ICS, and Microsoft environments. Critical Start backs every response time with a contractual SLA.

Chargebee provides revenue infrastructure, including subscription management, recurring billing, pricing, and usage-based monetization for AI and SaaS products. Its customers are AI, SaaS, and consumer subscription businesses.

EverCurrent sells an AI platform of record that connects the tools, data, and knowledge behind hardware so teams can see how changes spread. EverCurrent is sold to hardware product and engineering teams, which use it to manage engineering change, schedule risk, and team decisions.
